response.sql: WITH account_transactions AS (SELECT a.account_id, d.A3 as region, SUM(t.amount) as account_sum, COUNT(*) as transaction_count FROM trans t INNER JOIN account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id INNER JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id GROUP BY a.account_id, d.A3), region_sums AS (SELECT region, SUM(account_sum) as region_total FROM account_transactions GROUP BY region) SELECT at.account_id, at.region, at.account_sum, at.transaction_count, CAST(at.account_sum AS REAL) / NULLIF(rs.region_total, 0) as share FROM account_transactions at INNER JOIN region_sums rs ON at.region = rs.region ORDER BY share DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10;
